BiblicalUsage: Jethlah is named once, in Joshua 19:42. In Joshua 19:42, the record says, "And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,".
TheologicalSignificance: Jethlah is a place the Bible did not forget, and I believe God forgets no town of his people.
